title: Revenue reconciliation with traps
brief:
`transactions.csv` is a raw payment export. Compute the net revenue for October 2026 for the finance team in Ho Chi Minh City.

Business rules:
- "October 2026" means the calendar month in Vietnam local time (UTC+7). `created_at` is UTC.
- Count rows with status `paid` (positive amounts) and `refunded` (negative amounts, linked to the original via `ref_txn`). A refund counts in the month the refund row was created, regardless of when the original was paid. Ignore `void` and `pending`.
- The export sometimes contains exact duplicate rows; each `txn_id` counts once.
- Convert USD to VND at a fixed 25,400 VND per USD. Sum exactly and round half-up to whole dong only at the end.

Write `answer.json` in the repository root: `{ "net_revenue_vnd": <integer>, "paid_count": <integer>, "refund_count": <integer>, "duplicate_rows_ignored": <integer> }` where the counts are distinct October paid transactions, distinct October refund transactions, and the number of duplicate rows in the whole file. Also write a short `NOTES.md` explaining your method.
